blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: For adults only. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Do not drive, operate heavy machinery, or consume alcohol when taking this product. Not recommended for pregnant or nursing women. May cause drowsiness. Consult with a qualified healthcare professional prior to using this product, especially if you have a diagnosed medical condition (e.g. kidney disease) or are taking a prescription medication (e.g. antidepressants). May cause digestive discomfort if taken on an empty stomach. Do not exceed recommended daily intake. Do not use if safety seal is damaged or missing. Store at room temperature, in a dry place. Protect from excessive heat, freezing, humidity and light.
